concerns.text: FR-007 requires raising a `DataSchemaError` when required columns are missing, but no task implements this specific exception. T001 raises a generic `RuntimeError`, and no other task mentions `DataSchemaError`.

SC-001 mandates measuring the correlation coefficient between `Recommendation_Diversity` and `Learner_Diversity` against the null hypothesis (p < 0.05). No task explicitly computes or validates this correlation; existing modeling tasks only produce regression outputs.

SC-003 requires assessing the false‑positive rate of the residual permutation test (≤ 0.05). The permutation test task (T008) generates the null distribution but does not include a verification step that checks the false‑positive rate against the alpha level.

SC-005 demands that total compute time be measured and verified to stay ≤ 6 hours on the GitHub Actions free tier. T010 logs runtime, but no verification task asserts that the logged time meets the 6‑hour budget.
